company.shortDescription: Ethos Space Resources is a company that operates in the space industry.
company.description: Ethos Space Resources is a company that operates in the space industry.  It specializes in providing in-space propellant refueling and ground services for the emerging space economy, especially for the Starship vehicle developed by SpaceX. It also aims to support the deployment of a planetary sunshade, a geoengineering project that would cool Earth by reducing the amount of sunlight reaching the surface.
